description.blurb: The name "S/2003 J 12" means that it is a satellite (S) that was discovered in 2003 orbiting Jupiter (J), and that it was the 12th satellite of Jupiter discovered that year.
description.more: At a distance of about 11 million miles (17.8 million kilometers) from Jupiter, S/2003 J12 is the innermost of the known retrograde satellites (those which orbit Jupiter in the opposite direction from the planet's rotation). It takes almost 490 Earth days tocomplete one orbit, and its orbit is highly inclined with respect to Jupiter's equatorial plane. S/2003 J12 is less than a mile across ( about one kilometer), assuming an albedo of 0.04).
